description: s6. Topics and Projects are first-class wiki collections, arbitrarily nestable. Each is a directory with kovan.toml (schema_version, id, name, kind = "topic"|"project") plus a human-editable README.md wiki page. Topics and Projects SHARE the collection/tree machinery; `kind` distinguishes semantics only -- do not build two parallel trees. s43's CollectionNode. Enum-dispatch `kind`, no trait objects.
title: kovan redesign 06: Topic / Project / subtopic collection model
